listing.name: Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories (GBA) (ReKHCoM)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Keep stable versus prerelease clear. x86 Linux dependencies and optional HD mod using separate owned PC assets are distinct. Limits: Stable1.9.14 distinct from2.0 prerelease; optional HD mod needs separate owned PC assets. Platform betas differ. Upstream platforms: Stable Windows x86 and Linux x86 packages (32-bit); Android and ARMHF handheld betas are separate. Preserve32-bit Linux runtime dependencies. Original data: Own USA/Europe/Japan cartridge dump; native port based on Pheenoh/khcom matching decompilation. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
